scope: Uncalibrated synthetic software comparison, no scientific or novelty gate
truth_model: Sample initial state from declared Gaussian prior, then exact linear integrated white acceleration at each variable dt. Matched model knowingly favors the Gaussian estimators; not realistic imaging evidence.
paired_design: A seed reuses initial/process/standard measurement noise and uniform dropout draws in every regime. All estimators receive identical observations within a regime.
methods: last observed position hold, initialized at prior position mean
primary: Per-trajectory position RMSE, all 80 post-step times, paired Kalman-minus-hold and RTS-minus-Kalman differences. Negative difference is lower RMSE. Retain every trajectory loss/tie, no winner criterion.
secondary: Kalman and RTS velocity RMSE and full-state mean NEES; descriptive only, no confidence/calibration threshold
summary: Arithmetic mean per-trajectory RMSE and paired differences per regime; raw metrics/counts retained; no inference or statistical superiority
ties: Exact difference == 0; no epsilon or post-hoc tolerance
resources: CPU only, numpy, 2 cores/2GB budget; no GPU, downloads or training
failure_rule: Any exception aborts scoring; do not drop failed seeds. Any change after freeze requires new version and disclosure. Scoring only after publication confirmation.
